_docs: DOS settings fragments carried as data — Claude Code plugin settings cannot host these keys today. A bootstrap/installer step merges them into the user's settings.json.

loadAtStartup._docs: Files force-loaded into session context at startup by LoadContext.hook.ts. Paths relative to DOS_DIR. Injected as <system-reminder> blocks.

dynamicContext._docs: Dynamic context sections injected by LoadContext.hook.ts at session start. Set to false to disable.

dos.tagline: Claude Code is the model. DOS is the operating system.
